commits_data.message:
ETL2PCAPNG: Dissector for etw header and call MBIM dissector

This change has new dissector for etw event that will display the etw header, also it will call MBIM dissector to display MBIM message if the event is from MBIM provider

commits_data.title: ETL2PCAPNG: Convert etl file to pcapng format
commits_data.message:
ETL2PCAPNG: Convert etl file to pcapng format

Read etl file and convert it to pcapng format.

This change will read etw event header for etw dissector that will be added in a separate merge request and UserData for MBIM dissector, write those data to pcapng format when it is opened at first time in Wireshark.

The converted pcapng file is in the same folder of the original etl file, and the converted filename will include the modified time of the original etl file. So it won't be converted when it is re-opened if the modified time of the original etl file is not changed.
